title: 第15章 助城主夫人修行第16章 玄元气运瞳 玉腿值千金的孙幼薇

read2（）;这虚影覆盖了大半个宝库穹顶，图中星辰流转，仿佛囊括万界。
炼天图虚影一出现，便爆发出一股强大的吸力。
宝库中的灵石顿时剧烈震颤起来，一道道精纯的灵力从灵石中剥离出来，化作一道道肉眼可见的灵力洪流，如同百川归海般，疯狂地涌入炼天图虚影之中。
然后通过虚影转化为温和的灵力，注入楚枫的体内。
楚枫的丹田如同无底深渊，疯狂吞噬着这些灵力。
他体内的金丹在灵力的滋养下，变得越来越璀璨，修为也在飞速攀升。
金丹六重、金丹七重、金丹八重！
突破的感觉接连不断地传来，楚枫的气息越来越浑厚，周身的灵力波动也越来越强烈。
然而，突破到金丹境之后，每提升一重境界所需要的灵力都呈倍增长。
百万灵石看似庞大，但在炼天图的吞噬下，也在快速减少。
当最后一颗灵石炼化完之后，楚枫的修为也只停在了金丹八重。
“还是不够。”
楚枫微微皱眉，没能一举突破到元婴境，心中还是有些遗憾。
另一边，子书禾已经参悟完功法，正准备尝试修炼。
她在纳戒中翻找了一番，找出了一个小巧的白玉瓷瓶，瓷瓶上刻着：蜜露丹。
玉简中记载，服用此丹后，有助于更快地引动阴阳之气，提升修炼《天地阴阳秘典》的效率。
“刚好还有两颗。”
子书禾心中一喜，拔开瓶塞，一股清甜的香气扑面而来。
她倒出一颗圆润的丹丸，毫不犹豫地吞了下去。

丹药入口即化，一股清甜的药力瞬间扩散开来，游走于她的四肢百骸。
子书禾按照《天地阴阳秘典》的法门，开始运转灵力。
很快，她便感觉到一股温和的力量涌入体内。
“这功法果然玄妙。”
然而，没过多久，她便察觉到了不对劲。
她的脸颊绯红，眉头微蹙，长长的睫毛上沾着细密的汗珠，眼神中带着一丝迷茫。
“你怎么了？”
楚枫心中一紧，快步走到她身边，语气带着一丝关切。
子书禾抬起头，看向楚枫之时，喉咙不自觉地滚动了一下。
“这功法有问题，我体内好热……”
楚枫的目光下意识地扫过她身边的白玉瓷瓶，顿时眉头一皱。
他弯腰捡起瓷瓶，拔开瓶塞，凑到鼻尖闻了一下。
一股清甜的香气中，夹杂着一丝极其隐晦的媚药气息，瞬间让他明白了过来。
“你吃这里边的丹药了？”
子书禾点了点头，伸出微微颤抖的玉手，拿起身边的玉简，指着其中一段文字说道。
“这上边写着，服用此丹有助于修行，我才吃了一颗……”
见状，楚枫有些哭笑不得。
“这是提升欲望的媚药。”
“什么！”
子书禾浑身一颤，脸上的红晕瞬间蔓延到了耳根，甚至连脖颈都变得通红。

她终于明白过来，自己体内的燥热并非来自功法，而是因为服用了媚药。
心念及此，她恨不得找个地缝钻进去，脸颊烫得几乎要燃烧起来。

read2(); This shadow covers most of the dome of the treasure house, and the stars in the picture seem to encompass all realms.
As soon as the phantom of the Heaven Refining Diagram appeared, a powerful suction force erupted.
The spiritual stones in the treasure house suddenly trembled violently, and pure spiritual power was peeled off from the spiritual stones, turning into torrents of spiritual power visible to the naked eye. Like hundreds of rivers returning to the sea, they poured crazily into the phantom of the Heaven Refining Diagram.
Then it was transformed into gentle spiritual power through the phantom and injected into Chu Feng's body.
Chu Feng's dantian was like a bottomless abyss, wildly devouring these spiritual powers.
The golden elixir in his body became more and more brilliant under the nourishment of spiritual power, and his cultivation level also increased rapidly.
The sixth level of the golden elixir, the seventh level of the golden elixir, and the eighth level of the golden elixir!
The feeling of breakthrough came one after another, Chu Feng's aura became thicker and thicker, and the spiritual power fluctuations around his body became more and more intense.
However, after breaking through to the Golden Core Realm, the spiritual power required for each level of advancement doubled.
Millions of spiritual stones may seem huge, but they are also rapidly decreasing under the devouring of the Heaven Refining Diagram.
After the last spirit stone was refined, Chu Feng's cultivation level only stopped at the eighth level of the Golden Core.
"It's still not enough."
Chu Feng frowned slightly, feeling a little regretful that he could not break through to the Nascent Soul Realm in one fell swoop.
On the other side, Zi Shuhe has finished studying the exercises and is about to try to practice.
She rummaged through the ring and found a small white jade porcelain bottle with the words: Honeydew Pill engraved on it.
It is recorded in the jade slips that taking this elixir will help to activate the yin and yang energy faster and improve the efficiency of practicing the "Secret Book of Yin and Yang of Heaven and Earth".
"There happen to be two more."
Zi Shuhe was overjoyed and uncorked the bottle, and a sweet aroma hit his face.
She poured out a round pill and swallowed it without hesitation.
The elixir melted in her mouth, and a sweet medicinal power spread instantly, traveling through her limbs and bones.
Zi Shuhe began to use his spiritual power according to the method of "The Secret Code of Yin and Yang of Heaven and Earth".
Soon, she felt a gentle force pouring into her body.
"This technique is really mysterious."
However, it wasn't long before she noticed something was wrong.
Her cheeks were flushed, her brows were slightly furrowed, her long eyelashes were covered with fine beads of sweat, and there was a hint of confusion in her eyes.
"What's wrong with you?"
Chu Feng's heart tightened, and he quickly walked to her side with a hint of concern in his tone.
When Zi Shuhe raised his head and looked at Chu Feng, his throat rolled unconsciously.
"There's something wrong with this technique, my body is so hot..."
Chu Feng's eyes subconsciously glanced at the white jade porcelain bottle beside her, and he frowned immediately.
He bent down to pick up the porcelain bottle, uncorked it, put it to the tip of his nose and smelled it.
There was a sweet aroma mixed with an extremely obscure scent of love potion, which instantly made him understand.
"Have you taken the elixir here?"
Zi Shuhe nodded, stretched out his slightly trembling jade hand, picked up the jade slip next to him, pointed at one of the texts and said.
"It says here that taking this pill will help your practice, so I just took one..."
Seeing this, Chu Feng felt a little dumbfounded.
"It's a lust-boosting potion."
"What!"
Zi Shuhe trembled all over, the blush on his face instantly spread to his ears, and even his neck turned red.
She finally understood that the hotness in her body was not from the exercises, but from taking the love potion.
Thinking of this, she wanted to find a crack in the ground and crawl into it, her cheeks so hot that they almost burned.
